concerns.text: FR-005 requires the permutation test to execute **exactly 1,000 shuffles**. Task T009 performs a *nested* permutation test with 1,000 shuffles per outer fold, resulting in far more than 1,000 total shuffles and thus does not satisfy the specification.

FR-012 mandates that low‑performing (“null”) model results be reported without error. Task T007 aborts the pipeline if no model meets the validation R² lower‑CI ≥ 0.5, and T008 similarly assumes a best model exists, violating the requirement to produce a complete report even for null findings.

FR-013 requires computation of per‑predictor significance (p < 0.05) using linear model coefficients and inclusion of these values in the final report. No task in the current list (T001‑T016) addresses this computation or its reporting.
